title: Bright: a globally distributed multimodal building damage assessment dataset with very-high-resolution for all-weather disaster response
abstract_snippet: Presents the globally distributed Bright dataset pairing pre-event VHR optical imagery with post-event VHR SAR imagery for building damage assessment across multiple disasters.
relevance_blurb: Defines the benchmark, modalities, event diversity and three-level damage labels used by the project.

title: Advancing All-Weather Building Damage Mapping to the Instance Level: Outcomes and Insights from the 2026 Bright Challenge
abstract_snippet: Reports the instance-level Bright Challenge, two unseen test events, 46 final teams, and the architectures of the two winning solutions.
relevance_blurb: Contains the strongest direct evidence on modality-specific encoding, late fusion, optical-dominant localization and cross-event severity instability.
notes: Challenge outcomes preprint; winning solution repositories are linked from the paper.

title: Building-Guided Pseudo-Label Learning for Cross-Modal Building Damage Mapping
abstract_snippet: Uses pre-disaster optical building extraction followed by a cross-modal change detector and building-guided low-uncertainty pseudo-label refinement.
relevance_blurb: Directly addresses the same DFC 2025 optical-SAR building damage mapping task with a two-stage building-guided pipeline.

title: HeteCD: Feature Consistency Alignment and difference mining for heterogeneous remote sensing image change detection
venue: ISPRS Journal of Photogrammetry and Remote Sensing
abstract_snippet: Employs a non-shared Siamese Transformer, feature consistency alignment and a 3D spatio-temporal attention difference module for heterogeneous optical-SAR change detection.
relevance_blurb: Represents a feature-level alignment and difference-mining design for heterogeneous optical-SAR inputs.
notes: Supervised binary building change detection on XiongAn, not BRIGHT severity classification.

title: FlowMamba: Building Damage Assessment via Optics Flow-based State Space Model
venue: IEEE Transactions on Circuits and Systems for Video Technology
abstract_snippet: Combines differential optical-flow alignment, multiscale VMamba modeling and category-distance-aware supervision for building damage assessment.
relevance_blurb: Places changes at the cross-scale alignment/decoder and loss layers rather than only at the input stem.
notes: Official repository states TCSVT acceptance in December 2025.

title: M2CD: A Unified MultiModal Framework for Optical-SAR Change Detection with Mixture of Experts and Self-Distillation
abstract_snippet: Adds mixture-of-experts modules inside the backbone and a training-only Optical-to-SAR path with self-distillation for optical-SAR change detection.
relevance_blurb: Illustrates modality-specific capacity inserted within encoder stages and a training-objective intervention.
notes: Formal peer-reviewed venue was not verified.

title: SARMAE: Masked Autoencoder for SAR Representation Learning
abstract_snippet: Pretrains a SAR MAE with speckle-aware representation enhancement and a frozen optical semantic anchor on paired SAR-optical data.
relevance_blurb: Targets the SAR encoder/pretraining layer rather than a downstream fusion residual.

title: Superpixel Sampling Networks
abstract_snippet: Introduces a differentiable superpixel sampling model with task-specific learning and integration into downstream deep networks.
relevance_blurb: Provides the iterative differentiable clustering basis for the current local nine-candidate assignment module.

title: Learning Superpixels With Segmentation-Aware Affinity Loss
abstract_snippet: Learns pixel affinities using a segmentation-error-aware objective to preserve weak object boundaries in superpixel segmentation.
relevance_blurb: Motivates explicit boundary/affinity supervision when generic deep features fail to produce useful partitions.

title: Superpixel Segmentation With Fully Convolutional Networks
abstract_snippet: Predicts pixel-to-regular-cell association scores using an FCN and supplies differentiable downsampling and upsampling operations for dense prediction.
relevance_blurb: Matches the current regular-grid candidate representation and pool/unpool insertion point.

title: Boundary-Responsive Differentiable Gating for Superpixel-Based Segmentation
abstract_snippet: Separates learnable region creation, boundary-responsive gating and high-fidelity pixel refinement, with adjacency-based contrastive supervision.
relevance_blurb: Provides a structure for retaining efficient region reasoning without smoothing away boundary detail.

title: SRAC: Superpixel Retrieval-Augmented Classification for Multi-Modal Disaster Building Damage Assessment
abstract_snippet: The public institutional description states that the framework uses VMambaSSN superpixels and retrieval from a labeled memory to improve rare building-damage classification on BRIGHT.
relevance_blurb: Directly combines superpixel structure and retrieval-augmented classification on the same task and benchmark.
notes: Paper 2851 is verified in the official accepted list; public full paper, complete author list and official code were not located as of 2026-08-25.
